changes.title: Azure apimanagement: update Go naming customization (#48246)
AWS Backup adds logically air-gapped vault support for Amazon RDS
changes.detail: AWS Backup logically air-gapped vault now supports Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) DB instances. Logically air-gapped vaults are a type of AWS Backup vault that stores immutable, isolated backups, which are locked by default with AWS Backup Vault Lock in compliance mode. Secure sharing across accounts and AWS Organizations enables direct restore, reducing recovery time from a data loss event. You can now protect your Amazon RDS DB instances in logically air-gapped vaults. A logically air-gapped vault stores immutable backups that are locked by default, and isolated with encrypt
